_comment: Hand-maintained facts that are not in a data file. Keep in step with Chapter 5 and Figure 4.5 of the report. 'components' = the data-to-backtest steps that produced the reported results; 'capabilities' = each MLOps/DataOps capability, the AWS service in the design and the local equivalent that actually ran. Everything else is read from the report tables, reports/ and git.

components.name: EIA ingestion
components.detail: Daily Henry Hub gas (RNGWHHD) and WTI crude (RWTC), 2010 onwards

components.name: Validation and transformation
components.detail: Cleaning, 8 validation rules, 38 leakage-free features, chronological splits

components.name: Trading environment
components.detail: Custom Gymnasium environment with 0.1 % transaction costs and a stop-loss

components.name: PPO training and MLflow tracking
components.detail: Stable-Baselines3 PPO; every run logged to mlruns/

components.name: Backtest vs Buy & Hold and Random
Trade replay application
components.detail: Offline desktop replay of a trained agent

details: 300,000-step PPO training in 22 min 8 s (inside the 2-hour task timeout)
Model and metrics stored in MLflow (run 404abd89eb804a159b405989b4b60386)
Backtest report written to S3 (LocalStack); success email received
Fault-injection run with an invalid training budget: train_drl retried, run marked failed, one alert email (TC-17)
latest_dag_run.note: A single seed, used as evidence that the orchestration works, not as a trading result.

limitations: One held-out test period (414 trading days, December 2024 to July 2026) dominated by two weather-driven price spikes, so each result depends heavily on a few days.
Trading is simulated at each day's published spot price with a fixed 0.1 % transaction cost, without bid-ask spreads or market impact.
The reward does not penalise risk, and the agents accepted drawdowns of up to 53 %.
The main configuration was trained with five seeds and no hyperparameter search; full-test returns ranged from +67.0 % to +190.9 %.
The system has not been used for real trading, and none of the results supports acting on its decisions without a human trader reviewing them.

capabilities.local: Airflow 2.8.1 in Docker Compose: daily schedule, retries and a 2-hour timeout; all 8 tasks succeeded end to end (TC-14)
S3 API through LocalStack: raw data, processed splits, data-quality and backtest reports written by the DAG
transform.py run as the DAG's transform task
8 validation rules stop a bad run; the data_quality_report task stores a report for every run
MLflow 3.14 server in Docker for DAG runs, and the mlruns/ store behind every result in Chapter 5
Every trained model is stored as a versioned MLflow artefact; registry stages and an automatic quality gate were not implemented
Airflow emails on success and on failure, received in Mailpit (TC-17)
Airflow UI and task logs; training metrics in MLflow
Airflow image built from Dockerfile.airflow by Docker Compose
67 automated tests (pytest, with moto standing in for S3) pass
Fixed seeds, YAML config and a fixed data snapshot; re-evaluation reproduced the logged results exactly (TC-09)

capabilities.cloud: GitHub Actions deploying to ECR and MWAA
